text: PROPERTY LEASE AGREEMENT & WELCOME PACKET - THE OAKWOOD RESIDENCES 1. PROPERTY OVERVIEW AND APARTMENT SPECIFICATIONS Welcome to The Oakwood Residences, located at 742 Evergreen Terrace. This luxury apartment complex offers modern urban living combined with quiet neighborhood charm. Unit 4B is a spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment featuring premium hardwood floors, large floor-to-ceiling windows with south-facing views, and an open-concept kitchen equipped with energy-efficient stainless steel appliances. The property includes central air conditioning, smart home thermostat integration, high-security deadbolt locks, and pre-wired high-speed fiber optic internet connections throughout every room. 2. FINANCIAL TERMS: RENT, LATE FEES, AND DEPOSIT STRUCTURE The

monthly rent for Unit 4B is set at $2,250, payable on or before the 1st day of each calendar month via the secure online portal. Payments made after the 5th day of the month will incur a mandatory late fee of $75. A security deposit of $2,250 is required upon signing this lease agreement, which is fully refundable at the end of the tenancy subject to a standard property inspection for damages. Additionally, a non-refundable one-time pet deposit of $300 is mandatory for tenants keeping approved domestic pets, alongside a monthly pet rent of $25 per animal. 3. UTILITIES, MAINTENANCE,

AND EMERGENCY PROTOCOLS Monthly rent includes standard trash removal, pest control, and community sewage services. The tenant is individually responsible for electricity, high-speed internet, and water utility bills based on monthly consumption meters. Routine maintenance requests can be submitted through the online tenant portal 24/7 and are typically resolved within 48 business hours. Emergency maintenance issues, such as major plumbing leaks, gas odors, or electrical failures, should be reported immediately to the 24/7 emergency hotline provided in your onboarding welcome packet. 4. AMENITIES, PARKING, AND COMMUNITY GUIDELINES Residents have full, complimentary access to the community fitness center, heated outdoor swimming

pool, and rooftop terrace garden from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily. Designated parking space #42 is assigned exclusively to Unit 4B. Smoking is strictly prohibited inside all indoor common areas, hallways, and individual residential units. Quiet hours are strictly enforced between 10:00 PM and 7:00 AM every night to ensure a peaceful community environment for all neighboring residents.

PROPERTY LEASE AGREEMENT & WELCOME PACKET - MAPLEWOOD HEIGHTS 1. INTRODUCTION AND APARTMENT FEATURES Maplewood Heights presents Unit 12A, a cozy and highly efficient 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom loft situated at 1044 Maple Street. This unit features striking exposed brick accent walls, high 12-foot ceilings, in-unit washer and dryer appliances, and an updated modern kitchen with quartz countertops and custom wooden cabinetry. It is specifically designed for working professionals seeking a low-maintenance urban lifestyle close to downtown business districts, public transit hubs, and popular dining locations. 2. RENTAL PAYMENTS, SECURITY DEPOSIT, AND FEES The monthly rental rate for Unit 12A is $1,600,

due on the first calendar day of every month. A grace period is extended until the 4th of the month, after which a 5% late fee applies automatically. The security deposit equals exactly one month's rent ($1,600) and is held in an interest-bearing escrow account during the duration of the lease term. Key replacement costs $50 per physical key or electronic fob if lost, and returned check fees are assessed at $35 per incident. 3. UTILITIES, SERVICES, AND PARKING ARRANGEMENTS Gas and electricity are metered separately and paid directly by the tenant to the local utility providers before the monthly

due dates. Water and community trash disposal services are fully covered by the landlord. One uncovered parking stall is included in the lease agreement at no extra charge. Additional guest parking passes can be requested from the main leasing office for a nominal monthly fee of $25, subject to availability. 4. COMMUNITY AMENITIES AND HOUSE POLICIES Tenants enjoy 24-hour secure access to package lockers, a dedicated bicycle storage room, and the outdoor courtyard BBQ grill station. Subletting, short-term rentals, or listing the apartment on platforms like Airbnb are strictly forbidden without prior written consent from property management. All pets must
be registered with the management office prior to move-in, with a strict maximum limit of two domestic pets per household.

PROPERTY LEASE AGREEMENT & WELCOME PACKET - PINEWOOD ESTATES 1. PROPERTY DESCRIPTION AND INDOOR FEATURES Pinewood Estates Unit 8C is an expansive 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom suburban townhome located at 305 Pine Valley Road. Featuring a private fenced backyard, attached two-car garage, wood-burning fireplace in the main living room, and a generous walk-in master bedroom closet, this property provides exceptional comfort, storage space, and privacy for families. High-end carpeting, vaulted ceilings, and energy-double-pane windows come standard throughout the entire residence. 2. FINANCIAL POLICIES: RENT, DEPOSIT, AND PROCESSING FEES The monthly rent for this property is $3,100, due on the first of each

month via the automated tenant payment portal. A security deposit of $3,500 is required prior to taking possession of the keys. A refundable key and garage remote deposit of $150 is also collected at lease signing. Returned checks, disputed charges, or failed ACH transactions will incur a $40 bank processing fee, and late rent payments attract a flat fee of $100 after the fifth of the month. 3. UTILITIES, LAWN CARE, AND PROPERTY UPKEEP The tenant is directly responsible for all household utilities, including electricity, natural gas, municipal water, high-speed internet, and weekly curbside trash collection. Routine front yard lawn

care and community landscaping maintenance are managed and paid for by the landlord, while the tenant is strictly responsible for maintaining the private backyard grass area and patio in a clean, neat, and orderly condition year-round. 4. COMMUNITY AMENITIES AND GUIDELINES Pinewood Estates features a private neighborhood children's playground, professional tennis courts, and a community clubhouse available for private party reservations by residents. Homeowners association (HOA) rules apply to all residents; printed copies of the full HOA bylaws and community covenants are provided in the welcome folder.
